stable.notes: Ask about a live meeting. Live COS Ask sits beside the live transcript with presets and your own questions, keeps every question and answer with the meeting, reads files and screenshots you share, and lets you pick the meeting assistant model under the Ask box or in Settings. The menu bar and Dock show when a meeting records. Developer ID signed and Apple notarized. Pairs with server 6.70.0.

whatsNew.summary: Ask about a meeting while it records. Live COS Ask sits beside the live transcript, keeps every question and answer with the meeting, and lets you switch the meeting assistant model right under the Ask box. Pairs with server 6.70.0.

sections.title: Ask while it records
items: The menu-bar icon and a REC badge in the Dock show when a meeting is recording, even with the Meetings window closed.
Open the live transcript from the menu-bar panel, the Dock menu, a Dock click, or Command-Shift-L while COS Control is active.
Live COS Ask sits beside the live transcript with Catch me up, Summarize so far, Suggest questions, Action items and a question box. A model runs only when you ask.
Answers start from the current meeting and cite the lines they used. A question you type can also look in COS memory and earlier meetings.

sections.title: Ask keeps its history
items: Questions, answers and sources stay with the meeting after you switch meetings, save it or restart COS Control.
Unsent questions are saved too. Stop or retry an answer yourself, and nothing reruns on its own.
Saved meetings show their Ask history. Sources open the transcript line, earlier meeting, memory, file or web page they came from.

sections.title: Files, models and copy
items: Add files while a meeting records, or drop or paste a screenshot on the Ask box. Their text is read on this Mac and shared with Ask, and files it cannot safely read are labeled instead.
Pick the Meeting assistant model under the Ask box or in Settings. Haiku stays the default, and other chats keep their own models.
Copy full context adds every answer, its sources and file text to the transcript. Copy transcript on a saved meeting copies only the transcript.
Drag the divider to resize the Ask panel. The preset buttons line up on the left.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Ask keeps saving while the Mac is locked during a meeting. It no longer shows a false Check free disk space error.
A live transcript that keeps failing after a recording ends stops retrying after five minutes.
An older server shows an update message for Ask. The live transcript keeps working.
Ordinary public questions like who is or look up can search the web, with server 6.70.0. Only the words you typed go into a search, never your meeting details.

notice.title: Right-click the pet
notice.body: Right-click the pet for Full motion, Calm motion or No motion, or to hide it. Hidden, it comes back from COS Control in the menu bar, under Session pet. The pet also shows Codex threads while they work and Cursor chats mid-turn.
